subtests.name: A cookie set without HttpOnly is not http-only
A cookie set with HttpOnly is http-only
Adding HttpOnly to a cookie with an unchanged value makes it http-only
Removing HttpOnly from a cookie with an unchanged value makes it not http-only
Adding HttpOnly through a second Set-Cookie in the same response
Removing HttpOnly through a second Set-Cookie in the same response
Adding HttpOnly to a cookie with an unchanged value hides it from document.cookie
Removing HttpOnly from a cookie with an unchanged value exposes it to document.cookie
